name: Flex Carousel
description: WebGL image carousel where draggable cards pass through a bending lens that curls, twists and splits colors at the center. Includes intro animations, click-to-focus zoom, captions and a rolling counter.
contents: Looping row of image cards drawn on a WebGL canvas
Lens distortion layer with chromatic dispersion over the cards
Caption with title, optional subtitle and a rolling 2-digit counter below the cards
Screen reader live region announcing the current item
behavior: Infinite loop with spring snapping to the nearest card
Drag, touch swipe with inertia, horizontal wheel, vertical wheel (optional) and keyboard arrows, Home, End
Click a side card to center it, click the centered card to open a zoomed focus view, click or Escape to close
Intro animation plays once all images load (or after 3.5s): rise, bloom, spin, deal or fade
Cards shrink slightly while moving fast, lens squashes with scroll velocity when liquid is above 0
Optional autoplay that pauses on hover, press, focus, interaction and focus view
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden
Reduced motion swaps the intro for a fade and disables autoplay, liquid and parallax
editableByProps: Images, alt text, titles and subtitles through items
Lens look through preset and individual overrides: size, tilt, roundness, bend, reach, curl, dispersion, liquid, followCursor
Intro style, card height, gap, corner radius and aspect fit
Autoplay, interval, captions, click-to-focus and wheel capture
Selection callbacks through onChange and onSelect
Container size and caption text color through className or style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change caption typography or counter animation
needsCodeEdit.where: Digits component and the captions block in the returned JSX

needsCodeEdit.change: Change intro timings or add an intro style
Change the placeholder gray or card image zoom

fixed: Requires the ogl package and a WebGL2 browser, nothing renders without WebGL2
Root is h-full w-full, so the parent must have a defined height or the carousel collapses
Images load from remote URLs and need CORS headers (crossOrigin anonymous)
Wheel events over the carousel are prevented, so with captureWheel true vertical page scroll is blocked while hovering
Caption text inherits the page text color
Lens size is relative to container width, cards to container height
Canvas pixel count is capped by a 4.5 million pixel budget and dpr max 2
Touch uses vertical pan for page scroll and horizontal drag for the carousel, hover cursor and followCursor are ignored on touch
Works on small screens through container based sizing, with no breakpoint specific layout

options.look: Tall tilted lens that twists cards at its edges with strong color splitting and liquid squash
options.useWhen: A fashion or creative studio hero needs a showy, fluid centerpiece carousel

options.look: Square untilted lens that twists the row into a ribbon like curl
options.useWhen: A portfolio gallery needs a gentle, symmetric curve with balanced side distortion

options.look: Moderately tilted lens with stronger bend, giving a swirling pull on the outer cards
options.useWhen: A product launch or music page wants a dramatic, dynamic image strip

options.look: Untilted lens that lifts both sides upward so the row forms an arch
options.useWhen: A lookbook or photo series wants a clean arch shaped row with a calm focus on the center
